title: Career AI, deployed for National Career Service users
outcome: Zobique's own career tools run for users of India's national employment platform.
context: National Career Service (NCS) is India's national platform connecting job seekers and employers. Zobique Career AI is deployed for NCS users at ncs.zobique.com.
problem: Job seekers need help turning skills into job-ready applications.
built: Career AI job search, resume builder, ATS checker and roadmap, with their own sign-in.

components.name: Job search
components.detail: Matches a user's profile to relevant openings.

components.name: Resume builder
components.detail: Builds an ATS-friendly resume from the user's details.

components.name: ATS checker
components.detail: Checks a resume against applicant tracking systems before it is sent.

components.name: Career roadmap
components.detail: Lays out the skills and steps toward a target role.

flow: Gets matched roles and a roadmap
result: Live at ncs.zobique.com for NCS users.
resultDefinition: Status checked 16 Oct 2026; no usage numbers until measured.
